name: shell
title: Shell
description: The frame every screen sits in — a 44px global bar across the top, then a 64px module rail, the module's resizable column, the page under its 48px top bar with fixed slots, and a phone bottom bar — laid out in CSS before hydration, with the cookie state script and the floating area.

meta.whenToUse: The app's frame: the global bar, the rail of modules, a module's column, the page's top bar and the page, on every width from a 320px phone to a wide desktop window, in the browser and the desktop app.
meta.whenNotToUse: Sign-in, public and marketing pages (no shell), or a region inside a page (use a grid or ResizablePanelGroup).
